mapper.select: SELECT DATE(m.created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM message m WHERE m.sender_id = 0 AND m.type = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE(m.created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT COALESCE(c.ai_provider, ac.provider, 'unknown') AS provider, COUNT(*) AS count FROM message m LEFT JOIN conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id LEFT JOIN ai_conversation ac ON ac.id = m.conversation_id AND c.id IS NULL WHERE m.sender_id = 0 AND m.type = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ai_provider, ac.provider, 'unknown')
